title: [Bug][Subscription Billing] Rebilling usage data increases the subscription quantity once per subscription line
summary: Fixed rebilling of usage data for subscription lines so that subscription quantity increases only once instead of once per subscription line when a subscription has both customer and vendor lines with usage-based pricing.
key_points: Rebilled usage quantity was incorrectly applied multiple times per subscription due to repeated reads of the subscription header quantity
Captures subscription quantity once per run in a dictionary before processing any lines, eliminating double-counting across customer and vendor lines
Only affects rebilling scenarios with multiple usage-quantity subscription lines; non-rebilling usage data processing is unchanged
Existing subscriptions and posted documents are not affected by the behavioral change
Added test verifying correct single quantity increase when rebilling a subscription with both customer and vendor lines
quote: the subscription quantity is now increased by the rebilled quantity once, not once per subscription line
